title: incident-bot: add SLO toolkit on-call helpers and runbook auto-diagnostics
author: Nina Patel
description: Motivation: On-call responders often need quick access to the right runbook and SLO context during an incident. This PR integrates the SLO Toolkit utilities into incident-bot to surface SLOs and suggested runbooks automatically, and adds a set of on-call helper commands for faster diagnostics. Summary of changes: 1) New oncall helpers (pkg/oncall/helpers.go) that expose commands: /oncall runbooks, /oncall slo-summary, /oncall suggested-actions. Helpers use SLO Toolkit client to fetch SLO health and scoreboard summaries and rank candidate runbooks by recent invocation and similarity. 2) Auto-diagnostics trigger: incident-bot now runs a lightweight SLO-driven diagnostics pass when an SLO alert is linked to an incident; the diagnostics collects top-3 suspects, suggested runbook links, and critical traces and posts a compact block to the incident thread. 3) Runbook metadata enhancements: added optional runbook tags (service, slo_id, priority) and a small migration to attach tags to existing runbooks. 4) Telemetry and tracing: new metrics (incident_bot.oncall.autodiag.triggered, .runbook_suggested_count) and traces for diagnostics runs. 5) Tests: unit tests for helpers and an integration test fixture that simulates SLO alerts. Rollout plan: feature gated behind "oncall_autodiag" remote flag and controlled rollout to dev->staging->prod; default off for existing customers. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test fixture - [x] Metrics emitted - [x] Feature flag added - [x] Docs snippet for runbook tags - [x] Backwards-compatible migration for runbooks Testing notes: validated locally against SLO Toolkit mock, ran integration test in CI, manual smoke test in staging by simulating an SLO alert. Related: ENG-4521 (oncall workflows), ENG-4599 (runbook tagging).
commits: Add oncall helper commands and SLO toolkit client integration
Implement runbook metadata tags and migration
Add auto-diagnostics trigger and compact post format
Add unit and integration tests; update docs snippet

Asha Fernandez: Please add a feature flag and ensure it's off by default for existing tenants
Nina Patel: Feature flag added (oncall_autodiag) and defaulted to false; updated rollout notes
Jonah Kim: lgtm pending tests; one nit about error wrapping in client.go
Nina Patel: Addressed error wrapping and added an extra unit test for error paths
release_notes: Added on-call helpers and SLO-driven auto-diagnostics: exposes /oncall commands to list runbooks and SLO summaries, auto-generates suggested runbooks when an SLO alert is linked to an incident, adds runbook tagging metadata and telemetry. Feature behind feature flag oncall_autodiag.
summary: Integrates SLO toolkit into incident-bot to provide on-call helpers and automated runbook suggestions based on SLO alerts. Adds telemetry, tests, and migration for runbook tags. Feature gated and rolled out to staging before production.
